_comment: Single source of truth for the South Tampa neighborhood catalog and detail pages. Personality copy is Kevin-supplied. `draft` fields are AI-written and marked unreviewed until Kevin confirms them through the weekly review form (see scripts/email_neighborhood_review.py and /neighborhood-review/). Run scripts/build_neighborhoods.py after any edit.

districts.name: Hyde Park & Northeast South Tampa
districts.blurb: The oldest, densest and most walkable corner of South Tampa. Brick streets, front porches, and the closest thing Tampa has to a genuine urban village.

districts.name: Palma Ceia & Central South Tampa
districts.blurb: The residential heart. Oak canopies, brick streets, A-rated schools and quiet prestige. This is what most people picture when they say South Tampa.

districts.name: Bayshore & Southeast South Tampa
districts.blurb: From the stately homes lining Bayshore Boulevard down through Ballast Point and the fast-changing Gandy corridor.

districts.name: Western & Waterfront South Tampa
districts.blurb: Big lots, mature landscaping and canal frontage. Where South Tampa gets quiet, private and boat-accessible.

districts.name: Port Tampa
districts.blurb: Old Florida, geographically and culturally its own thing. It started as a separate town and it still feels like one.

districts.name: South Tampa-Adjacent
districts.blurb: Frequently marketed as South Tampa, though locals will tell you these are northern-edge neighborhoods or separate areas entirely. Worth knowing before you tour.

historic-hyde-park.name: Historic Hyde Park
historic-hyde-park.personality: Classic, polished and walkable. Historic homes, shaded streets, front porches and a strong sense of old Tampa, with upscale shopping and dining nearby.

hyde-park-village.name: Hyde Park Village
hyde-park-village.personality: Stylish, manicured and social. Boutique shopping, brunch, fitness studios, events and a luxury lifestyle atmosphere. It is technically a commercial district within Hyde Park rather than a separate residential neighborhood.

soho.name: SoHo
soho.personality: Young, energetic and restaurant-driven. Popular with professionals who want nightlife and walkability, but not necessarily peace and quiet.

hyde-park-spanishtown-creek.name: Hyde Park Spanishtown Creek
hyde-park-spanishtown-creek.personality: Historic, tucked away and slightly more eclectic than central Hyde Park. It feels like a hidden transition between downtown-oriented living and traditional residential streets.

bayshore-gardens.name: Bayshore Gardens
bayshore-gardens.personality: Compact, central and convenient. A mixture of older homes, apartments, condominiums and townhomes close to Bayshore, Hyde Park and downtown.

dobyville-west-hyde-park.name: Dobyville / West Hyde Park
dobyville-west-hyde-park.personality: Historically significant, urban and rapidly changing. It has deeper cultural roots and more architectural variety than the polished sections of Hyde Park.

courier-city-oscawana.name: Courier City-Oscawana
courier-city-oscawana.personality: Dense, lively and urban. Apartments, townhomes, restaurants and older homes create a more active, less suburban version of South Tampa. Portions are included in District 4.

davis-islands.name: Davis Islands
davis-islands.personality: Friendly, self-contained and waterfront-oriented. It has a small-town island personality, a neighborhood business district and a strong outdoor lifestyle despite being minutes from downtown.

harbour-island.name: Harbour Island
harbour-island.personality: Polished, controlled and downtown-adjacent. More condominiums, townhomes and gated living than traditional neighborhood streets. Many people group it with South Tampa, although it feels more connected to downtown.

palma-ceia.name: Palma Ceia
palma-ceia.personality: Quintessential South Tampa. Brick streets, mature oak trees, established homes and quiet prestige without feeling excessively flashy.

palma-ceia-pines.name: Palma Ceia Pines
palma-ceia-pines.personality: Eclectic, connected and urban-residential. It mixes houses, apartments, businesses, schools and churches, creating a more varied atmosphere than traditional Palma Ceia.

palma-ceia-west.name: Palma Ceia West
palma-ceia-west.personality: Comfortable, residential and family-oriented. It is central and established, but generally quieter and less formal than the streets surrounding the Palma Ceia Golf and Country Club.

virginia-park.name: Virginia Park
virginia-park.personality: Neighborly, active and family-focused. Older homes sit beside substantial new construction, giving it a traditional neighborhood structure with a continually updated appearance.

golfview.name: Golfview
golfview.personality: Refined, quiet and established. It has an understated estate-home personality and feels closely connected to Palma Ceia's country-club side.

parkland-estates.name: Parkland Estates
parkland-estates.personality: Elegant, intimate and highly polished. Historic architecture, mature landscaping and limited through traffic give it a secluded feeling despite its central location.

new-suburb-beautiful.name: New Suburb Beautiful
new-suburb-beautiful.personality: Charming, discreet and historically upscale. It offers leafy residential streets near SoHo without feeling like part of the nightlife district.

swann-estates.name: Swann Estates
swann-estates.personality: Practical, central and residential. It has a mixture of traditional homes and newer rebuilds, with less ceremony than Golfview or Parkland Estates.

culbreath-heights.name: Culbreath Heights
culbreath-heights.personality: Hidden, quiet and conveniently located. It feels like a small residential pocket surrounded by better-known neighborhoods.

san-rafael-place.name: San Rafael Place
san-rafael-place.personality: Tiny, private and enclave-like. This is one of those micro-neighborhood names that many Tampa residents have heard but could not easily point to on a map.

palma-ceia-commercial-district.name: Palma Ceia Commercial District
palma-ceia-commercial-district.personality: Local, independent and community-oriented. Small restaurants, professional offices and neighborhood businesses give it more of a traditional main-street personality than a shopping-center atmosphere.

bayshore-beautiful.name: Bayshore Beautiful
bayshore-beautiful.personality: Stately, calm and traditionally upscale. It feels closely connected to Bayshore Boulevard while remaining more residential than Hyde Park. The City describes it as containing some of Tampa's most elegant homes.

ballast-point.name: Ballast Point
ballast-point.personality: Laid-back, historic and waterfront-focused. Old Florida porches, newer construction, mature trees and Ballast Point Park give it a relaxed personality.

fair-oaks-manhattan-manor.name: Fair Oaks-Manhattan Manor
fair-oaks-manhattan-manor.personality: Down-to-earth, neighborly and centrally located. It has a more modest, mid-century residential feel and less of the formal luxury atmosphere associated with northern South Tampa.

belmar-gardens.name: Belmar Gardens
belmar-gardens.personality: Small, quiet and low-key. It feels more like an everyday residential neighborhood than a recognizable lifestyle district.

bel-mar-shores.name: Bel Mar Shores
bel-mar-shores.personality: Waterfront-oriented, relaxed and varied. Canal homes and boating access give portions of it a coastal personality, while interior streets feel more traditionally suburban.

bayside-west.name: Bayside West
bayside-west.personality: Practical, mixed-density and convenient. Condominiums, townhomes and single-family homes make it less visually uniform than Palma Ceia or Virginia Park.

interbay.name: Interbay
interbay.personality: Evolving, unpretentious and strategically located. Residential streets mix with commercial and industrial edges, giving it a younger and more transitional personality.

interbay-south-of-gandy.name: Interbay-South of Gandy
interbay-south-of-gandy.personality: Outdoorsy, convenient and increasingly residential. Access to Gadsden Park and the Greenway adds an active lifestyle component.

gandy-sun-bay-south.name: Gandy-Sun Bay South
gandy-sun-bay-south.personality: Broad, varied and fast-changing. Older ranch homes, apartments, townhomes and new infill create several different personalities within one large area.

south-gandy.name: South Gandy
south-gandy.personality: Urbanizing, convenient and development-heavy. It appeals more to people seeking newer apartments, townhomes and quick transportation access than historic architecture.

southtown-park.name: Southtown Park
southtown-park.personality: Planned, newer and low-maintenance. It has more of an HOA or townhome-community personality than a traditional Tampa neighborhood.

rembrandt-gardens.name: Rembrandt Gardens
rembrandt-gardens.personality: Quiet, modest and tucked away. It feels like a small residential subdivision within the larger South Gandy area.

rattlesnake.name: Rattlesnake
rattlesnake.personality: Casual, funky and unmistakably local. The informal name is commonly associated with the western Gandy area, marinas, boating and an older, slightly gritty version of South Tampa.

macdill-air-force-base-area.name: MacDill Air Force Base Area
macdill-air-force-base-area.personality: Military-centered, active and highly practical. It influences commuting patterns, businesses and the personality of many neighborhoods south of Gandy, but the base itself is not a conventional residential neighborhood.

beach-park.name: Beach Park
beach-park.personality: Polished, spacious and car-oriented. Mature landscaping, larger lots and a mix of historic homes and luxury construction give it a private residential feeling close to Westshore and the airport.

beach-park-isles.name: Beach Park Isles
beach-park-isles.personality: Private, boating-oriented and upscale. Canals and waterfront properties create more of a secluded coastal-suburb atmosphere than traditional Beach Park.

sunset-park.name: Sunset Park
sunset-park.personality: Leafy, spacious and quietly affluent. Mature trees, residential streets and Old Tampa Bay sunsets give it a peaceful, established personality.

sunset-park-isles.name: Sunset Park Isles
sunset-park-isles.personality: Secluded, waterfront and boating-focused. This is the more private, canal-oriented side of Sunset Park.

culbreath-isles.name: Culbreath Isles
culbreath-isles.personality: Gated, exclusive and estate-like. Large waterfront homes, boating access and controlled entrances give it one of South Tampa's most private personalities.

culbreath-bayou.name: Culbreath Bayou
culbreath-bayou.personality: Lush, secluded and waterfront-oriented. It feels slightly less formal than Culbreath Isles while still offering an established upscale atmosphere.

south-westshore.name: South Westshore
south-westshore.personality: Relaxed, residential and slightly removed. It offers proximity to the water, MacDill and Gandy without the busy personality of Hyde Park or SoHo.

stoney-point.name: Stoney Point
stoney-point.personality: Private, coastal and enclave-like. It has a tucked-away waterfront personality that many residents outside South Tampa rarely encounter.

westshore-marina-district.name: Westshore Marina District
westshore-marina-district.personality: New, polished and resort-inspired. Apartments, condominiums, restaurants, walking areas and marina access create a master-planned waterfront lifestyle rather than an old neighborhood feeling.

port-tampa-city.name: Port Tampa City
port-tampa-city.personality: Historic, independent and Old Florida. It began as its own town and still feels geographically and culturally separate from central South Tampa. Picnic Island and its railroad and maritime history contribute to the small-town personality.

port-tampa.name: Port Tampa
port-tampa.personality: The broader name people use for Port Tampa City and its surroundings. Casual, water-oriented, military-adjacent and less polished than northern South Tampa.

picnic-island-area.name: Picnic Island Area
picnic-island-area.personality: Recreational, coastal and outdoorsy. It is more of a destination and geographic reference point than a formal residential neighborhood.

north-hyde-park.name: North Hyde Park
north-hyde-park.personality: Urban, transitional and development-driven, with older homes, former industrial buildings and substantial new construction.

bon-air.name: Bon Air
bon-air.personality: Modest, central and residential, with easy access to Kennedy Boulevard and Westshore.

gray-gables.name: Gray Gables
gray-gables.personality: Small, quiet and centrally located between several better-known neighborhoods.

westshore-business-district.name: Westshore Business District
westshore-business-district.personality: Corporate, convenient and transportation-oriented. It is an employment and shopping district rather than a traditional neighborhood.
